title: Self-Reliance & Other Essays
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translator: From Essays: First Series (public domain, Project Gutenberg #2944)
blurb: America's great essayist on trusting yourself, on love, and on friendship — short, quotable and fearless.

nonconformist.m: Someone who doesn't follow the crowd's rules.
nonconformist.e: The nonconformist wore sandals to the wedding.

hobgoblin.m: A mischievous imp; a silly fear.
hobgoblin.e: Worry about trends was his hobgoblin.

consistency.m: Always doing or saying the same thing.
consistency.e: Consistency matters in training a puppy.

cards.title: Trust yourself
cards.text: Emerson's call: trust your own thoughts. Every heart responds to that iron string of self-trust.
cards.quote: Trust thyself: every heart vibrates to that iron string.
cards.qMean: Believe in yourself; everyone feels the pull of self-trust.
cards.qLife: Choosing the career you love over the 'safe' one.
cards.cap: Caspar David Friedrich - Wanderer above the sea of fog · public domain

cards.title: Be a nonconformist
cards.text: To be your own person, you must not simply follow the crowd's idea of right.
cards.quote: Whoso would be a man, must be a nonconformist.
cards.qMean: To be truly yourself, you can't just follow everyone else.
cards.qLife: Wearing what you like instead of what's trending.

cards.title: Foolish consistency
cards.text: Don't be trapped by what you said yesterday. Changing your mind when you learn more is a strength.
cards.quote: A foolish consistency is the hobgoblin of little minds
cards.qMean: Refusing to change your mind is a small-minded habit.
cards.qLife: Admitting you were wrong about a restaurant after trying it.
cards.cap: Autumn Landscape on the Hudson River, by Jasper Francis Cropsey · public domain

cards.title: Misunderstood greatness
cards.text: Socrates, Jesus, Galileo and Newton were all misunderstood. Being misunderstood is not a sign you're wrong.
cards.quote: To be great is to be misunderstood.
cards.qLife: An inventor laughed at before the idea succeeds.
cards.cap: Galileo before the Holy Office · public domain

cards.title: Be a friend
cards.text: You can't buy or chase friendship. The only way to have a friend is to be one.
cards.quote: the only way to have a friend is to be one.
cards.qMean: To have friends, be a good friend first.
cards.qLife: Calling to check on someone instead of waiting for them to call.
cards.cap: Two Friends by Oliver Ingraham Lay (1877) · public domain

cards.title: All love a lover
cards.text: Everyone warms to someone in love; love brings out kindness and grace even in rough people.
cards.qMean: Everyone likes seeing someone in love.
cards.qLife: The whole office smiling at a colleague's engagement news.
cards.cap: Frank Bernard Dicksee - Romeo and Juliet, 1884 · public domain
